title: His testers said this ship is useless in the first levels
lines: His testers said the biggest machine in his snowplow game is useless in the early levels.
To be fair, it's a ship. An icebreaker. Built for frozen seas.
So he dropped it into the very first driveway.
And then it parked next to a grandma and refused to move.
The last thirteen percent is still out there.
So, the testers were half right. Think you could finish it?
